Applicability.title: Cancellation Policy Applicability
Applicability.description:
Applicability mode of the cancellation policy.

Creation

Start

StartDate

FeeExtents.description: Extent for the cancellation fee, i.e. what should be in scope for the automatic payment.

ApplicabilityOffset.description: Offset for order start (assuming Applicability is set to Start) from which the fee is applied in ISO 8601 duration format.

FeeMaximumTimeUnits.description: Maximum number of time units the cancellation fee is applicable to.

RelativeFee.description: Relative value of the fee, as a percentage of the reservation price.
